as_told.title: Van Flandern and Harrington both died of throat cancer

plain: Two astronomers, Thomas Van Flandern and Robert Harrington, who led the search for an unknown planet in our solar system and possibly a companion star to the Sun, both died of throat cancer even though neither of them smoked, according to the researcher Matt LaCroix. He tells Michels this without naming a source the first time; the second time he points to a book called The Stage of Time and stresses that it was the two of them who led the search for the planet and the star. LaCroix raises it because he finds it striking that the two men leading the same search died of the same uncommon illness.
